course_position.stage_name: Toward B1 - Complex Conversations and Narratives

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice conditional planning when a social plan depends on availability.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Trying to arrange dinner, fika, or an after-work plan around a practical condition.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining how one condition would change a plan.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss a social plan that depends on getting a table, finishing work, or finding time.

main_focus.name: conditional planning with om and skulle
main_focus.description: Use om + past tense with skulle to describe what would happen if a practical condition were met.
model_examples: Om vi fick bord, skulle vi kunna äta där.
Om jag slutade tidigare, skulle jag följa med.

useful_chunks: Jag skulle följa med om jag hann.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical planning words and keep the condition easy to understand.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker suggests a social plan.
dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss one or two conditions that would make the plan possible.
dialogue_shape.ending: They decide to book, wait, or choose a backup plan.

target_complexity.repetition: repeat conditional planning in realistic turns

focus: the condition that affects whether it can happen
what backup or next step is chosen

sentence_focus: one sentence with om vi fick
one sentence with skulle kunna for a plan
one sentence about booking a table
one sentence about following along if there is time
one sentence combining a condition with a backup decision
